_about: The World of Questions: entry points into Omega42 by category, with sample questions anyone can ask at once (site: questions.html and the home page). Three levels: featured questions (here), community questions (from submissions) and Navigator-generated questions (Questions Worth Asking, weekly in the Discovery Bulletin). A suggested approach is a starting point; the Navigator classifies each question itself (docs/QUESTION_NAVIGATION.md). Proposal by ChatGPT 6 (OpenAI), relayed by the Originator, 20 November 2026.
principle: No subject is excluded from exploration because it is unconventional, controversial, speculative or outside current scientific consensus. The method of exploration and the status of every resulting statement stay transparent: what a source says, what a person reports experiencing, what a tradition teaches, what sources share, what can be independently checked, what is an interpretation, what remains unexplained, and what is speculative or metaphysical.
